purpose: Planning taxonomy for evidence routing,not a complete Harbour grammar or implemented-family count. Each observed manual tag has one primary workstream; sources can span workstreams. Seed compile evidence is linked,not promoted to runtime or complete coverage.
contracts_note: Phase/next-gate text does not authorize changes. In particular shared preprocessor permission and new representation/ownership/Dyn effects remain separate.
